title: brother_printer: truthful probe note, pyusb auto-install, stuck-job detection
objective: ./run.sh says why the USB probe was skipped instead of falsely blaming pyusb, installs python-pyusb itself, and reports a stalled job or a hung backend of a cancelled job instead of 'Printing / processing job'.
acceptance_criteria: While CUPS prints, the fallback note reads 'USB status probe skipped: CUPS has a job on the printer'
run.sh checks /usr/bin/python3 for usb.core and runs pacman -S --needed python-pyusb when it is missing
A frozen job-impressions-completed counter for 15 s reports cups:job-stalled
A usb://Brother backend whose job is no longer queued reports cups:backend-orphaned and offers a SIGKILL
brother_printer tests pass at 100% branch coverage
out_of_scope: Physical paper-feed problems on the HL-1110
